threads.name: The treasure map
threads.note: The party is following a map whose marked locations they do not recognize, and the treasure has not been found.

threads.name: The Clurichen of the riverbanks
threads.note: Reginald warned of a trickster creature that comes into town nightly. Sir Phidipaldi's claims about it were shown wrong, but what it is up to remains unknown.

threads.name: The black dragon near Brandonsford
threads.note: The dragon, Eric's 1000-gold bounty, George's account and Gill's sons' hunt are all one danger and pursuit, and none of it is settled.

threads.name: Hiring Lady Hilda
threads.note: Lady Hilda offered to join a paid party against the dragon, and Sir Phidipaldi said they would come back for her services after seeing the Reeve (beat_10).

threads.name: Drop Dead Ned's offer
threads.note: Ned offered himself and his killer wasp for hire, and Dr. Uriah said he would think about it.

threads.name: The missing shipments to Brandonsford
threads.note: Bentley's shipment never arrived and nothing has come into town for months. Why remains unknown, and Wayman asked whether anyone had gone after it.

threads.name: Sir Phidipaldi's quarrel with Eric the Reeve
threads.note: Sir Phidipaldi insulted the bounty-giver and challenged him to a duel. Eric declined, but the ill will and Bentley's ruling sending Phidipaldi to the Golden Egg leave relations strained.

threads.name: Shamus the mule
threads.note: Gill offered the mule for 100 gold, and Dunk asked about trading work for it. Dunk is sleeping on the offer.

threads.name: Warwick's mithril chain shirt
threads.note: A superb mithril shirt that Warwick refuses to sell is a potential prize for the party.

threads.name: Quinn's vanishing ale
threads.note: Quinn's stock disappears nightly and he blames Bentley. Sir Phidipaldi agreed to a 100-gold fake-shipment plan that has not yet been carried out.

standalone_beats.reason: Brandonsford has no real law enforcement, only a night watch, which is useful background but tied to no thread.
The party gained entry to town; this was consequential but left nothing open.
The party learned the lodging terms at the Clumsy Fox.
Ingrid is where to get potions; this is a local resource not tied to any thread.
